What's new in 0.1.91:
- Jellyfin-compatible mode (Beta): Jellyfin apps cannot approve Quick Connect codes, app passwords stop when the account sign-in changes and expire after one year, the two-step rule is checked first, and playback tickets end with their Jellyfin sign-in.
- Home: the Layout picker closes after you choose a layout, on Escape and on an outside click, and keyboard focus returns to it.
- Phone speakers: the false "typical of Bluetooth" wording is replaced by neutral text in all six languages. A note explains when phones hold every seat so this computer plays nothing. The Add output button has a clear name.
- Not yet checked: a real Jellyfin app, real phones for the speaker changes, translations by native speakers, and the final installed Windows upgrade and in-app update.
- Release source commit e2b1dabbf559cf086f68c787a66b08a8a49cc8e5.
- Published: Oct 18, 2026, 6:32 PM Eastern.
